annotations.title: Plan a remake for your product

description:
Plan a launch video for the user's product, using a Kuchi reference as an inspiration template.

Pass the user's own product details and assets, and your shot_analysis: the kind of each reference shot, read from the storyboard sheets of kuchi_get_breakdown. Returns what to borrow from the reference (rhythm, color roles, motion), a blueprint that re-times the reference's shots to the target length on whole frames and says what content of the user's goes in each shot, the rules for using a reference, and missing_inputs: questions to ask the user before building. ready=false means required inputs are missing. Shots without a kind keep their exact timing and get placeholder content.

Call it again with the user's answers and your analysis until ready=true and every shot has a kind. Only list assets the user actually gave you. It does not render video; build it with your own tools, then call kuchi_check_remake.

aspect_ratio.description: Output ratio; defaults to the reference's

assets.description: Assets the user has provided. Only list assets the user actually gave you.

description.description: What it shows, e.g. 'Dashboard, dark mode'

location.description: URL or file path, if the user gave one. Kuchi never opens it.

call_to_action.description: The closing line or URL, e.g. 'Try it at acme.com'

fps.description: Frame rate you will render at, e.g. 30 or 60; defaults to the reference's. The blueprint's frame numbers use it.

key_features.description: 1-3 features or moments to show, most important first

product_description.description: What the product does and who it is for, in the user's words

reference.description: A Kuchi video id ('34'), slug, Kuchi link (https://kuchi.kalarislabs.com/#video-34) or the original X post URL

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for readable text, 'json' for structured data

shot_analysis.description: Your reading of the reference's shots from its storyboard sheets. One entry per shot; send as many as you have analysed.

kind.description: What the shot is; kuchi_get_breakdown describes each kind

shot.description: The reference shot's number, from kuchi_get_breakdown

shows.description: One line on what is on screen and where it sits, e.g. 'Dashboard centered, sidebar left, cursor moves to a button'

shot_offset.description: Blueprint shots to skip, for references with many shots

target_seconds.description: Target length in seconds; defaults to the reference's length

name: kuchi_plan_remake
title: Plan a remake for your product
